scope: Raw retained evidence from six real final-package CPU/CUDA evaluation cases and three identical-weight backend comparisons on public COCO8 Val. No new inference or model-quality claim is made by archiving.

dataset_provenance.purpose: Public ground-truth data for inference pipeline integration, not representative football accuracy
dataset_provenance.configuration_changes: Set absolute QA dataset path and remove automatic download instruction; names and split unchanged
dataset_provenance.negative_target: COCO original class ID 32: sports ball; val has zero annotated instances

dataset_note: Only public COCO8 validation images and ground-truth are used. This tiny set checks integration mechanics; it is not a football accuracy, deployment or generalization benchmark. No private user dataset is included.

pt_torchscript_cpu.note: Same weights only; different YOLO architectures are not expected to have equal accuracy.

onnx_cpu_cuda.note: Same weights only; different YOLO architectures are not expected to have equal accuracy.

pt_cpu_cuda.note: Same weights only; different YOLO architectures are not expected to have equal accuracy.

torchscript_export_result.source: Original JSON result line in torchscript-export/conversion.stdout.log, not a separate original JSON file.

limitations: COCO8 is a tiny pipeline integration set, not a deployment benchmark or football accuracy claim.
CUDA comparisons apply to identical weights and record explicit numeric tolerances.
Image decoding does not replace interaction assertions.
No physical camera or Windows 2.3.1 evaluation acceptance.
Zero-result sports-ball case tests absent-target handling; COCO sports ball is not football-specific.

visual_inspection.method: Opened the retained PNG pixels with view_image after complete Pillow decode. No generated stand-in or altered screenshots.
observations: The ONNX CUDA analysis screenshot shows four COCO8 Val samples, class 0 → class 0, actual saved full-set metrics, analysis threshold and deployment configuration action in the existing dark UI. Lower analysis content is reached through its scroll area.

The PT CPU preview shows the public COCO8 umbrella image with a blue GT person box, prediction box, TP label and original class ID 0. Some table class text uses standard ellipsis at the narrow column width.
limitations: Only these two keyframes were visually inspected; all thirty PNG files were fully decoded. Metrics are tiny integration-set observations, not football model quality or performance claims.
